author: Eileen Campbell
text: I use the logbook to enter each dose of insulin. Since I don't take any other diabetes meds, this is an important function for me.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: Perhaps this is just the perspective of a very old man, but even two or three years ago I didn’t find the logbook to be useful at all… Since I can call up a visual chart showing me half a day or one day or one week of blood sugars, that is much easier for me to use when trying to determine trends.

author: Gene Holcombe
text: It’s no longer an automatic log book.  You have to manually enter the results.  Since Libre is continuous readings you should always see readings without having to log anything

author: Barrie Linch
text: Steve Kuckuk I'm old, too but I must say I find the logbook really helpful. It pinpoints when I've injected and the dosage. I suppose we all work in different ways, though.
